text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Beaten to the line, huh. You really 
are strong, Taishin."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I... am the one that someone as 
strong as you... believes in.

On our way back to the academy, Winning 
Ticket suddenly shouted out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No fair, no fair, no fair, it's so not 
faaaair!! Like... like, both Taishin and 
Hayahide are doing so great, and here I 
am~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wandaaa!! I wanda run wid both of youuuu 
toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, you... you brought this on yourself, 
didn't you? Since you ended up getting 
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—All three of us are still in the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, as long as we both desire 
it, we can compete against each other... 
time and time again."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, the Autumn Tenno 
Sho!! Let's run there!!

"See you at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)"— With 
those parting words, they went their 
separate ways.
